result.summary: The image depicts a complex urban intersection featuring embedded trolley tracks and multiple travel lanes. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the pedestrian environment is compromised by faded crosswalk markings, narrow walkways obstructed by utility poles, and the inherent tripping hazards of the rail infrastructure.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Steel rails embedded in the asphalt create tripping hazards for pedestrians and slipping hazards, especially when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Running through the center of the intersection and along the roadway.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, crossing the street from the left corner.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and signage are placed within the narrow sidewalk, reducing the effective clear width for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or zebra-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The environment is dominated by a wide multi-lane roadway with embedded trolley tracks and no visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure. While a sidewalk exists on the far side, the lack of traffic calming, poor pavement quality, and long crossing distances create a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uneven pavement and tracks
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and uneven around the trolley tracks, creating a significant tripping hazard for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks any marked crossings or refuge islands, forcing pedestrians to traverse multiple lanes of traffic unprotected.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the road

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in stages.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair the degraded pavement and level the area around the tracks to eliminate tripping hazards.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a sidewalk on at least one side of a two-lane road, though it suffers from significant vegetation overgrowth and a lack of marked crossings. The presence of a large blank wall and faded pavement markings further reduces the sense of safety and comfort for people walking.

hazards.name: Vegetation overgrowth
hazards.description: Shrubs and weeds on the right side are encroaching on the sidewalk, reducing the effective walking width.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible crosswalks or pedestrian signals, which may encourage unsafe mid-block crossings.

hazards.name: Faded lane markings
hazards.description: Worn-out road markings reduce the predictability of vehicle paths, increasing risk for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Regular maintenance to clear the sidewalk of overgrowth and ensure the full width is accessible.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implementation of high-visibility crosswalks to provide designated and safer crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Installing curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a mid-block urban street with a wide but poorly maintained concrete sidewalk. The environment lacks pedestrian-oriented features such as street trees or buffers, and the adjacent building frontages are largely inactive with roll-down shutters.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A utility pole is located within the sidewalk area, reducing the effective width for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Maintenance
hazards.description: Cracked pavement and weed growth create uneven surfaces that may cause tripping.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sidewalk slabs to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters to provide a buffer between pedestrians and traffic and improve the streetscape.
